ex.en: Our teacher explained adverbial phrases using simple everyday examples.
ex.zh: 老师用简单的日常例子讲解了状语短语。

ex.en: Understanding adverbial clauses helps language learners express relationships between events more precisely in academic writing.
ex.zh: 理解状语从句有助于语言学习者在学术写作中更准确地表达事件之间的关系。

tip: adverb是词类；adverbial可指单词、短语或从句的状语功能。

senses.en: Harmful or making success and progress more difficult.

ex.en: Our ferry was cancelled because of adverse weather conditions.
ex.zh: 由于天气恶劣，我们的渡轮航班取消了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can have adverse effects on residents' sleep and mental health.
ex.zh: 长期接触交通噪声可能对居民的睡眠和心理健康产生不良影响。

tip: adverse指不利的；averse指反感的，常接to。

senses.en: relating to aircraft or aviation

ex.en: We saw an old aero engine at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一台老式航空发动机。

ex.en: Improvements in aero engine design can reduce fuel consumption and emissions from commercial aircraft.
ex.zh: 航空发动机设计的改进可以降低商用飞机的油耗和排放。

tip: 多用于名词前；aero-也常作航空相关前缀。

senses.en: The study of air movement and its effects on objects.
The qualities affecting how efficiently an object moves through air.

ex.en: We explored aerodynamics by testing paper planes in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里试飞纸飞机，探索空气动力学。

ex.en: Advances in aerodynamics allow aircraft manufacturers to reduce fuel consumption without significantly compromising passenger capacity or flight speed.
ex.zh: 空气动力学的进步使飞机制造商能够降低油耗，而不会明显牺牲载客量或飞行速度。

tip: 指学科时虽以s结尾，通常仍接单数谓语。

senses.en: To officially connect a person or group with an organisation.
An organisation officially connected with a larger organisation.

ex.en: Our local cycling club is affiliated with a national organisation.
ex.zh: 我们当地的自行车俱乐部隶属于一个全国性组织。

ex.en: Small research institutes often affiliate with universities to gain access to specialist equipment and academic expertise.
ex.zh: 小型研究机构常与大学建立隶属关系，以获得使用专业设备和借助学术专长的机会。

tip: 名词词尾读 /ət/，动词词尾读 /eɪt/。

senses.en: Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty

ex.en: Seasonal allergies afflict my brother whenever the flowers bloom.
ex.zh: 每到鲜花盛开时，季节性过敏就让我的哥哥备受困扰。

ex.en: Water shortages continue to afflict rural communities, limiting agricultural production and increasing the burden on local families.
ex.zh: 缺水问题持续困扰农村社区，限制农业生产，并加重当地家庭的负担。

tip: 常用被动be afflicted with，后接疾病或困境。

senses.en: the process of combining separate items into a larger whole
a group or collection of things brought together

ex.en: Automatic aggregation brings all my spending into one monthly report.
ex.zh: 自动汇总功能把我的所有开销整合成一份月度报告。

ex.en: The aggregation of regional climate data allows researchers to identify broader patterns that individual observations may miss.
ex.zh: 汇集区域气候数据，能让研究人员识别出单次观测可能遗漏的更广泛规律。

tip: 强调把分散项汇成整体；数据处理中常见。

senses.en: A state of worry or excitement that prevents calm behaviour.
Organised efforts to persuade people to demand political or social change.
The action of shaking or stirring a substance.

ex.en: Her agitation grew as she searched for her missing keys.
ex.zh: 她寻找丢失的钥匙时，变得越来越焦躁。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise may increase agitation and reduce residents' ability to concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 长期接触交通噪声可能加剧居民的烦躁情绪，降低他们在家中的专注力。

tip: 通常不可数；既可指情绪不安，也可指搅动。

senses.en: Worry intensely while trying to make a difficult decision

ex.en: I agonized over which course to choose all weekend.
ex.zh: 整个周末，我都在为选哪门课而纠结。

ex.en: Many graduates agonize over whether to pursue further education or enter an increasingly competitive job market.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生为继续深造还是进入竞争日益激烈的就业市场而苦恼。

tip: 常用agonize over/about；英式也拼作agonise。

senses.en: An illness, especially one that is not serious.

ex.en: The pharmacist suggested a remedy for my stomach ailment.
ex.zh: 药剂师为我的胃部不适推荐了一种药。

ex.en: Treating minor ailments at local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals and improve access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 在社区诊所治疗小病能减轻医院压力，并让人们更方便地获得医疗服务。

tip: 可数名词，通常指小病，常搭配 minor。

senses.en: having no clear purpose, plan, or direction

ex.en: We spent the afternoon on an aimless walk.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在漫无目的地散步。

ex.en: Without clear learning goals, students may engage in aimless online browsing rather than developing useful research skills.
ex.zh: 如果没有明确的学习目标，学生可能只会漫无目的地浏览网页，而非培养实用的研究技能。

tip: aimless是形容词；修饰wander等动词用aimlessly。

senses.en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs
an established route used by aircraft

ex.en: The nurse checked that the patient's airway was clear.
ex.zh: 护士检查了病人的气道是否通畅。

ex.en: Heavy traffic along a major airway requires careful coordination to keep aircraft safely separated.
ex.zh: 主要航路上的繁忙交通需要精心协调，以确保飞机保持安全间距。

tip: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。

senses.en: Make someone feel unwelcome or unwilling to support you

ex.en: His constant complaints alienated even his closest friends.
ex.zh: 他不停地抱怨，连最亲近的朋友都疏远了他。

ex.en: Public transport policies may alienate residents if local authorities fail to explain their benefits clearly.
ex.zh: 如果地方政府未能清楚解释公共交通政策的好处，这些政策可能会失去居民的支持。

tip: 常指使人疏远或失去支持，不表示挪用。

senses.en: The feeling of being disconnected from other people or society.
Separation from meaningful work, personal identity, or human potential.

ex.en: Joining a local choir eased her sense of alienation.
ex.zh: 加入当地合唱团缓解了她的疏离感。

ex.en: Rapid urban development can deepen residents' alienation when familiar neighbourhoods are replaced by anonymous apartment blocks.
ex.zh: 当熟悉的街区被缺乏特色的公寓楼取代时，快速的城市开发可能加深居民的疏离感。

tip: 日常多指疏离感；哲学、社会学中可指异化。

senses.en: Burning or shining brightly.
To get off a vehicle or land on a surface.

ex.en: The candles were still alight when we arrived.
ex.zh: 我们到达时，蜡烛还燃着。

ex.en: Passengers should wait until the bus has stopped completely before they alight from the vehicle.
ex.zh: 乘客应等公交车完全停稳后再下车。

tip: 形容词通常作表语；下车用alight from。

senses.en: The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position.
Agreement between ideas, aims, or actions.
An association between groups sharing political aims or interests.

ex.en: The mechanic checked the alignment of my front wheels.
ex.zh: 修理工检查了我的前轮定位。

ex.en: Closer alignment between school curricula and workplace needs could improve employment prospects for young graduates.
ex.zh: 学校课程与职场需求更加协调，有助于改善年轻毕业生的就业前景。

tip: in alignment with可指位置对齐或目标一致。

senses.en: to make pain, suffering, or a problem less severe

ex.en: A warm bath helped alleviate the ache in my shoulders.
ex.zh: 洗个热水澡帮助缓解了我的肩膀酸痛。

ex.en: Expanding affordable housing could alleviate pressure on low-income families and reduce the risk of homelessness.
ex.zh: 增加可负担住房可以减轻低收入家庭的压力，并降低无家可归的风险。

tip: 直接接痛苦或问题；表示减轻，不一定彻底消除。

senses.en: To assign resources to particular people, activities, or purposes.

ex.en: We allocated one cupboard to all our baking equipment.
ex.zh: 我们专门腾出了一个橱柜来放所有烘焙用具。

ex.en: Local authorities should allocate more funding to public transport in areas with limited access to essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应向基本服务不易获取的地区投入更多公共交通资金。

tip: allocate sth to sb/sth表示将某物分配给某人或某项用途。

senses.en: A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements.
To combine a metal with another element.

ex.en: This bicycle frame is made from a lightweight alloy.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车的车架由轻质合金制成。

ex.en: Engineers are developing stronger alloys to reduce vehicle weight and improve fuel efficiency.
ex.zh: 工程师正在开发更坚固的合金，以减轻车辆重量并提高燃油效率。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词常读/əˈlɔɪ/。

senses.en: to refer to something without mentioning it directly

ex.en: He alluded to a surprise but gave no details.
ex.zh: 他暗示会有个惊喜，但没有透露细节。

ex.en: The report alludes to funding difficulties without explaining how they might affect the proposed transport improvements.
ex.zh: 报告间接提及资金困难，却没有解释这些困难可能如何影响拟议的交通改善项目。

tip: 固定用allude to，不直接接宾语；勿混elude。

senses.en: relating to high mountains, especially the Alps

ex.en: Tiny alpine flowers grew between rocks beside the trail.
ex.zh: 小小的高山花朵生长在小径旁的岩石缝中。

ex.en: Rising temperatures threaten alpine ecosystems by reducing snow cover and forcing mountain species to move higher.
ex.zh: 气温上升使积雪覆盖减少，并迫使山地物种向更高处迁移，从而威胁高山生态系统。

tip: 泛指高山环境用小写；专指阿尔卑斯山常大写。

senses.zh: 心情矛盾的；态度摇摆的
senses.en: having conflicting feelings about someone or something

ex.en: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
ex.zh: 对于搬离家人这件事，我的心情很矛盾。

ex.en: Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.
ex.zh: 许多消费者对网购仍持矛盾态度，因为便利与隐私方面的担忧需要权衡。

tip: 常接about；指好坏感受并存，不是毫不在意。

senses.en: To change a document, rule, or plan to improve it.

ex.en: Please amend the booking to include one extra guest.
ex.zh: 请修改预订，增加一位客人。

ex.en: Parliament may amend existing legislation to ensure that remote workers receive the same protections as office employees.
ex.zh: 议会可能修订现行法律，确保远程工作者获得与办公室员工相同的保护。

tip: 常指修改文件或法律；修理实物通常用mend。

senses.en: Something done to repair harm or show regret.

ex.en: I baked her a cake to make amends.
ex.zh: 我给她烤了一个蛋糕，以此赔罪。

ex.en: Companies should make amends for environmental damage by restoring habitats and compensating affected communities.
ex.zh: 企业应通过恢复栖息地和赔偿受影响的社区来弥补造成的环境损害。

tip: 名词通常用make amends；不说an amends。

senses.en: Friendly, pleasant, and easy to get along with.

ex.en: Our amiable neighbour always stops to chat by the gate.
ex.zh: 我们那位和蔼的邻居总会在门口停下来聊几句。

ex.en: An amiable manner can help healthcare professionals build trust with patients from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 亲切的态度能帮助医护人员与来自不同文化背景的患者建立信任。

tip: amiable多形容人；amicable多形容关系或协议。

senses.en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.

ex.en: This cleaning liquid contains ammonia, so keep the window open.
ex.zh: 这种清洁液含有氨，所以要开着窗户。

ex.en: Ammonia emissions from agriculture can contribute to air pollution and damage sensitive natural habitats.
ex.zh: 农业产生的氨排放会加剧空气污染，并破坏脆弱的自然栖息地。

tip: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。

senses.en: a unit used to measure electric current

ex.en: This small lamp draws less than one ampere.
ex.zh: 这盏小灯的电流不到一安培。

ex.en: Students measured the current in amperes to compare the electrical requirements of different household appliances.
ex.zh: 学生们以安培为单位测量电流，以比较不同家用电器的用电需求。

tip: 符号为A；口语常缩为amp，复数加s。

senses.en: Enough or more than enough for a particular purpose
Large enough to provide plenty of room

ex.en: We have ample time for breakfast before the train leaves.
ex.zh: 火车出发前，我们有充足的时间吃早餐。

ex.en: Providing ample green space in residential areas can improve public health and encourage more active lifestyles.
ex.zh: 在住宅区提供充足的绿地能够改善公众健康，并鼓励更积极的生活方式。

tip: ample强调足够甚至有余，常修饰time、space、evidence。

senses.en: the process of making a sound or signal stronger
an increase in the strength or effect of something

ex.en: Without amplification, nobody could hear the singer outside.
ex.zh: 没有扩音设备，外面的人谁也听不到歌手的声音。

ex.en: The amplification of misleading claims through social media can undermine public trust in scientific research.
ex.zh: 误导性言论通过社交媒体被放大，可能削弱公众对科学研究的信任。

tip: 常指声音、信号的增强，也可指影响被放大。

senses.en: a device that increases the strength of sound or electrical signals

ex.en: He connected his guitar to a small amplifier.
ex.zh: 他把吉他接到了一台小型扩音器上。

ex.en: An amplifier can make a speaker's voice clearly audible throughout a large lecture hall.
ex.zh: 扩音器可以让整个大型报告厅都清楚地听到演讲者的声音。

tip: amplifier放大信号；speaker把信号转为声音。

senses.en: to make a sound or electrical signal stronger
to increase the strength or effect of something
to explain something further by adding details

ex.en: This small speaker amplifies music from my phone.
ex.zh: 这个小音箱把我手机播放的音乐放大了。

ex.en: Social media can amplify public concerns about pollution, encouraging local authorities to respond more quickly.
ex.zh: 社交媒体能够放大公众对污染的担忧，促使地方政府更迅速地回应。

tip: 既可放大实际声音，也可增强影响或情绪。

senses.en: To surgically remove all or part of a limb.

ex.en: The vet had to amputate the cat's badly injured leg.
ex.zh: 兽医不得不截去这只猫受伤严重的腿。

ex.en: Early treatment of severe infections can reduce the need to amputate limbs and improve patients' quality of life.
ex.zh: 及早治疗严重感染能够减少截肢的必要性，并改善患者的生活质量。

tip: 主要用于手术切除肢体，不能泛指切除所有器官。

senses.en: Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.

ex.en: Our shared kitchen is analogous to a busy workshop.
ex.zh: 我们的共用厨房就像一个忙碌的工坊。

ex.en: The role of public libraries is analogous to that of schools in supporting lifelong learning within communities.
ex.zh: 在支持社区终身学习方面，公共图书馆的作用与学校类似。

tip: 常用be analogous to，强调某方面可作比较。

senses.en: something similar to another thing in function or structure
using continuously varying signals rather than digital information

ex.en: This wooden model is an analogue of the bridge.
ex.zh: 这个木制模型是那座桥的对应模型。

ex.en: Researchers use a mechanical analogue of the human heart to investigate how blood flows through damaged valves.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用模拟人类心脏的机械装置，研究血液如何流经受损的瓣膜。

tip: 名词指对应物；形容词指模拟式，区别于digital。

senses.en: the scientific study of the structure of living bodies
the physical structure of a human, animal, or plant

ex.en: We studied anatomy using a plastic model of the heart.
ex.zh: 我们用一个塑料心脏模型学习解剖学。

ex.en: A thorough knowledge of human anatomy helps medical students understand how injuries affect movement.
ex.zh: 深入了解人体解剖学有助于医学生理解损伤如何影响运动。

tip: anatomy侧重身体结构，physiology侧重生理功能。

senses.en: Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles.
Thin, with bones and joints that appear prominent.

ex.en: The angular table looked striking beside our curved sofa.
ex.zh: 那张棱角分明的桌子放在我们的弧形沙发旁格外醒目。

ex.en: The museum's angular design contrasts sharply with the rounded forms commonly found in the surrounding landscape.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆棱角分明的设计与周围景观中常见的圆润形态形成鲜明对比。

tip: 形容外形棱角分明，也可形容人瘦削。

senses.en: Someone who strongly opposes another person.
A character who opposes the main character in a story.

ex.en: The detective finally faced her antagonist in the empty theatre.
ex.zh: 那位女侦探终于在空荡荡的剧院里直面她的对手。

ex.en: In many novels, the antagonist challenges the central character's values rather than simply threatening their physical safety.
ex.zh: 在许多小说中，对立角色挑战的是主角的价值观，而不仅仅是威胁其人身安全。

tip: 故事中的antagonist与主角对立，不一定是坏人。

senses.en: the study of humans, their societies, cultures, and development

ex.en: My cousin studies anthropology and collects stories about family traditions.
ex.zh: 我的表姐学习人类学，并收集有关家庭传统的故事。

ex.en: Anthropology helps researchers understand how cultural traditions influence attitudes towards health, education, and family life.
ex.zh: 人类学帮助研究者理解文化传统如何影响人们对健康、教育和家庭生活的态度。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；研究者称anthropologist。

senses.en: too old or outdated to be suitable for modern use

ex.en: The office still relies on an antiquated heating system.
ex.zh: 这间办公室仍然依赖一套陈旧过时的供暖系统。

ex.en: Replacing antiquated railway infrastructure could improve passenger safety and reduce delays across the national transport network.
ex.zh: 更换陈旧的铁路基础设施，可以提高乘客安全水平，并减少全国交通网络的延误。

tip: 含贬义，强调旧到不合时宜；antique可指珍贵古物。

senses.en: a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation
an expert estimate of how much something is worth

ex.en: My manager praised my progress during today's performance appraisal.
ex.zh: 经理在今天的绩效评估中表扬了我的进步。

ex.en: A thorough appraisal of environmental risks should take place before any major construction project begins.
ex.zh: 任何大型建设项目启动之前，都应对环境风险进行全面评估。

tip: appraisal是评估；别与approval（批准）混淆。

senses.en: to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something
to estimate how much money something is worth

ex.en: The coach appraised my technique and suggested some changes.
ex.zh: 教练评估了我的动作技巧，并提出了一些改进建议。

ex.en: Local authorities must appraise the environmental impact of major construction projects before granting planning permission.
ex.zh: 地方政府在批准规划许可之前，必须评估大型建设项目对环境的影响。

tip: appraise是评估；不要与apprise（告知）混淆。

senses.en: by an amount that is large enough to notice

ex.en: The room felt appreciably warmer after we closed the window.
ex.zh: 关上窗户后，房间里明显暖和了。

ex.en: Expanding reliable public transport could appreciably reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in urban areas.
ex.zh: 扩大可靠的公共交通服务可以明显缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 表示变化大到可察觉，不是“感激地”。

senses.en: A natural ability to learn or do something well

ex.en: Leila showed an aptitude for music at school.
ex.zh: 莱拉在学校里展现出了音乐天赋。

ex.en: Schools should recognise practical aptitude as well as academic achievement when advising students about careers.
ex.zh: 学校在为学生提供职业建议时，既应重视学业成绩，也应认可实践方面的天赋。

tip: 常用aptitude for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: based on chance or personal choice rather than clear reasons
using power according to personal wishes rather than fair rules

ex.en: Her choice felt arbitrary: she picked without even looking.
ex.zh: 她的选择显得很随意：她连看都没看就选了。

ex.en: Arbitrary restrictions on university admissions can prevent capable students from accessing education and may reinforce existing social inequalities.
ex.zh: 大学招生中缺乏合理依据的限制可能让有能力的学生无法入学，并加剧现有的社会不平等。

tip: 重点是缺乏合理依据，不只是“可以自由选择”。

senses.en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work

ex.en: The arduous climb left us exhausted but deeply satisfied.
ex.zh: 这段艰苦的攀登让我们筋疲力尽，却也十分满足。

ex.en: Restoring damaged ecosystems is an arduous process that requires sustained investment and cooperation between scientists and local communities.
ex.zh: 修复受损生态系统是一个艰巨的过程，需要持续投资以及科学家与当地社区的合作。

tip: 强调长期费力，常修饰task、journey、process。

senses.en: the highest social class, traditionally holding inherited titles and privileges
government by people belonging to a privileged hereditary class

ex.en: This grand house once belonged to the local aristocracy.
ex.zh: 这座豪宅曾属于当地贵族。

ex.en: Land ownership historically allowed the aristocracy to exercise considerable influence over political decisions and rural employment.
ex.zh: 历史上，土地所有权使贵族阶层能够对政治决策和农村就业施加重大影响。

tip: 指贵族阶层整体时通常用the aristocracy。

senses.en: To cause a feeling, interest, or reaction.
To wake someone from sleep.

ex.en: The locked wooden box aroused my curiosity immediately.
ex.zh: 那个上锁的木盒立刻引起了我的好奇。

ex.en: Proposals to replace public parks with commercial buildings are likely to arouse strong opposition among local residents.
ex.zh: 用商业建筑取代公共公园的提案很可能激起当地居民的强烈反对。

tip: arouse 后接宾语；arise 表示“出现”，不接宾语。

senses.en: In a way that suggests superiority to other people.

ex.en: He arrogantly dismissed my suggestion without even listening.
ex.zh: 他连听都没听，就傲慢地否定了我的建议。

ex.en: Managers who behave arrogantly may discourage employees from sharing ideas that could improve workplace efficiency.
ex.zh: 行为傲慢的管理者可能使员工不愿分享那些能提高工作效率的想法。

tip: 带贬义；自信地通常用confidently。

senses.en: A blood vessel carrying blood away from the heart.
A main road or route carrying heavy traffic.

ex.en: The doctor explained how blood flows through an artery.
ex.zh: 医生解释了血液如何流经动脉。

ex.en: The new railway will become a major transport artery connecting rural communities with regional markets.
ex.zh: 这条新铁路将成为连接乡村社区与区域市场的交通大动脉。

tip: 动脉将血液送离心脏；静脉是vein。

senses.en: able to express ideas clearly and effectively
to express thoughts or feelings clearly in words

ex.en: Our articulate neighbour explained the problem clearly at dinner.
ex.zh: 我们那位善于表达的邻居在晚餐时把问题解释得很清楚。

ex.en: Schools should help students articulate their opinions clearly while encouraging them to consider alternative perspectives.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生清楚表达自己的观点，同时鼓励他们考虑不同的看法。

tip: 形容词词尾读/lət/，动词词尾读/leɪt/。

senses.en: to move upwards or rise to a higher position
to go up something such as stairs or a mountain

ex.en: We watched the balloon ascend slowly into the clear sky.
ex.zh: 我们看着气球缓缓升上晴朗的天空。

ex.en: As hikers ascend the mountain, they encounter distinct vegetation zones shaped by changing temperatures and moisture levels.
ex.zh: 徒步者登山时，会遇到由温度和湿度变化形成的不同植被带。

tip: 较正式；ascend the stairs中不加up。

senses.en: To consider something to be caused by a particular factor
To assign a quality, work, or statement to someone

ex.en: I ascribe my better sleep to regular evening walks.
ex.zh: 我认为睡眠改善得益于每晚定时散步。

ex.en: Researchers should not ascribe differences in academic performance solely to individual effort without considering social circumstances.
ex.zh: 研究人员不应在未考虑社会环境的情况下，将学业表现的差异完全归因于个人努力。

tip: 固定结构ascribe A to B：把A归因于B。

senses.en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.
A breath of air released when pronouncing certain speech sounds.

ex.en: Her greatest aspiration is to open a small bakery.
ex.zh: 她最大的愿望是开一家小面包店。

ex.en: Access to affordable higher education can help young people fulfil their aspirations, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 无论家庭收入如何，获得负担得起的高等教育都能帮助年轻人实现抱负。

tip: 抱负义常用复数；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

senses.en: To strongly want to achieve something important.

ex.en: My younger sister aspires to become a wildlife photographer.
ex.zh: 我妹妹立志成为一名野生动物摄影师。

ex.en: Many young people aspire to careers that offer both financial security and opportunities to contribute to society.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人向往既能提供经济保障，又能让自己为社会作贡献的职业。

col: aspire to a career in medicine
tip: aspire to do表立志做；aspire to后也可接名词。

senses.en: the deliberate murder of an important person, often for political reasons

ex.en: The museum guide explained how the assassination changed history.
ex.zh: 博物馆讲解员解释了那次暗杀如何改变了历史。

ex.en: The assassination of a political leader can trigger widespread instability and undermine public confidence in government.
ex.zh: 政治领导人遭暗杀可能引发广泛动荡，并削弱公众对政府的信心。

tip: 通常指针对重要人物、带政治目的的谋杀。

senses.en: a violent physical attack on someone
to attack someone physically

ex.en: A witness reported the assault to a nearby police officer.
ex.zh: 一名目击者向附近的警察报告了这起袭击事件。

ex.en: Better street lighting may reduce the risk of assault and help residents feel safer after dark.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可能降低人身袭击风险，让居民在天黑后更有安全感。

tip: 名词常接on；动词直接接人，不加介词。

senses.en: a confident statement that something is true
the act of firmly expressing rights, authority, or independence

ex.en: Her assertion that the shop was closed proved wrong.
ex.zh: 她断言商店已经关门，结果证明她错了。

ex.en: The assertion that economic growth always improves wellbeing requires careful examination of social and environmental evidence.
ex.zh: 经济增长总能改善福祉这一断言，需要通过仔细审视社会和环境证据来检验。

tip: 常用the assertion that…；断言不代表已有证据。

senses.en: A promise intended to remove doubt or worry.
Confidence in your abilities or in what you believe.

ex.en: She gave me her assurance that dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 她向我保证晚餐已经准备好了。

ex.en: Residents sought an assurance from the council that the new development would not reduce access to public parks.
ex.zh: 居民要求地方议会保证，新开发项目不会影响公众前往公园。

tip: 表示具体保证时可数；表示自信时通常不可数。

senses.en: Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country.
An old term for a hospital for people with mental illnesses.

ex.en: Her family sought asylum after fleeing their home country.
ex.zh: 她的家人逃离祖国后寻求庇护。

ex.en: Governments should assess asylum applications fairly while ensuring that vulnerable applicants have access to legal advice.
ex.zh: 政府应公平审理庇护申请，同时确保弱势申请人能够获得法律咨询。

tip: 表示庇护时不可数；指精神病院是过时用法。

senses.en: having sides or parts that do not match
unequal between people, groups, or sides

ex.en: The jacket has an asymmetric collar and deep pockets.
ex.zh: 这件夹克的领子不对称，口袋很深。

ex.en: Asymmetric access to market information can place small businesses at a disadvantage when negotiating with larger firms.
ex.zh: 市场信息获取的不对等，可能使小企业在与大公司谈判时处于不利地位。

tip: 既可指形状不对称，也可指信息或力量不对等。

senses.en: Relating to the gases surrounding Earth or another planet.
Creating a strong and distinctive mood or feeling.

ex.en: We found an atmospheric café tucked behind the old theatre.
ex.zh: 我们在老剧院后面发现了一家很有氛围的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Changes in atmospheric conditions can affect agricultural production and increase the frequency of extreme weather events.
ex.zh: 大气状况的变化会影响农业生产，并增加极端天气事件发生的频率。

tip: 修饰pressure指大气的；修饰场所常指富有氛围的。

senses.en: To reach a goal or level, usually through effort.

ex.en: After months of practice, she attained her target swimming speed.
ex.zh: 经过几个月的练习，她达到了自己的目标游泳速度。

ex.en: Students from disadvantaged backgrounds may need additional support to attain the qualifications required for university entry.
ex.zh: 来自弱势家庭的学生可能需要额外支持，才能获得大学入学所需的资格。

tip: 正式及物动词，直接接目标或水平，不加to。

senses.en: caused by or explainable as the result of something

ex.en: The damp patch is attributable to a leaking pipe.
ex.zh: 这块潮湿的痕迹是水管漏水造成的。

ex.en: Much of the improvement in public health is attributable to cleaner drinking water and better sanitation.
ex.zh: 公共健康状况的改善，很大程度上归功于更清洁的饮用水和更好的卫生设施。

tip: 固定搭配be attributable to，to后接原因。

senses.en: the act of identifying something's cause, creator, or source
acknowledgement of the person who created or supplied something

ex.en: Please include an attribution when you share my photograph.
ex.zh: 分享我的照片时，请注明作者。

ex.en: Accurate attribution of environmental damage to specific industries is essential for developing fair and effective regulations.
ex.zh: 准确判定环境损害应归因于哪些行业，是制定公平有效的法规的关键。

tip: 不是普通的“属于”；常指认定原因、作者或来源。

senses.en: To increase something by adding to it.

ex.en: She sells homemade jam to augment her income.
ex.zh: 她出售自制果酱来增加收入。

ex.en: Digital resources can augment classroom teaching, but they should not replace meaningful interaction between teachers and students.
ex.zh: 数字资源能增强课堂教学效果，但不应取代师生之间有意义的互动。

tip: 较正式，通常作及物动词，强调通过添加来增加。

senses.en: Relating to hearing or the sense of hearing

ex.en: Our music teacher uses games to develop aural skills.
ex.zh: 我们的音乐老师通过游戏培养听辨能力。

ex.en: Language courses should include regular aural practice so that learners can understand different accents in everyday communication.
ex.zh: 语言课程应安排定期的听力练习，使学习者能在日常交流中听懂不同口音。

tip: aural指听觉的；oral指口头的或口腔的。

senses.en: Trusted as accurate because of expert knowledge.
Showing confidence and an ability to command respect.

ex.en: This gardening guide offers authoritative advice on growing vegetables.
ex.zh: 这本园艺指南提供了种植蔬菜的权威建议。

ex.en: Students should consult authoritative sources when evaluating health claims shared widely through social media platforms.
ex.zh: 学生评估社交媒体平台上广泛传播的健康说法时，应查阅权威资料。

tip: 勿混authoritarian：后者指专制的。

senses.en: The freedom or right to make decisions independently.

ex.en: My new manager gives me more autonomy at work.
ex.zh: 我的新经理给了我更多工作自主权。

ex.en: Giving schools greater autonomy may help teachers adapt their lessons to the specific needs of local communities.
ex.zh: 赋予学校更大的自主权，可能有助于教师根据当地社区的具体需求调整课程。

tip: 通常不可数；既指地区自治，也指个人或机构自主。

senses.zh: 积压的工作；待处理订单
senses.en: work or orders waiting to be dealt with

ex.en: I stayed late to clear a backlog of emails.
ex.zh: 我加班到很晚，清理积压的邮件。

ex.en: Hiring additional staff could help hospitals reduce the backlog of patients waiting for routine operations.
ex.zh: 增聘工作人员可以帮助医院减少等候常规手术的积压患者人数。

tip: 常用a backlog of，指本应处理却积压的事项。

senses.en: an instrument that measures air pressure
something that indicates changes in a situation or condition

ex.en: We checked the barometer before sailing across the bay.
ex.zh: 我们驾船横渡海湾前查看了气压计。

ex.en: Consumer confidence is often regarded as a useful barometer of a country's overall economic health.
ex.zh: 消费者信心常被视为衡量一国整体经济健康状况的有效指标。

tip: 比喻某种状况的指标时，常用a barometer of。

senses.en: A man holding a low-ranking title of nobility.
A wealthy person with great power in a particular industry.

ex.en: The baron welcomed his guests into the castle courtyard.
ex.zh: 男爵迎接客人们来到城堡庭院。

ex.en: Media barons can influence public debate through their ownership of major newspapers and television networks.
ex.zh: 传媒大亨可以凭借对主要报纸和电视网的所有权影响公共讨论。

tip: 本义为男爵；行业名词加baron可指该行业大亨。

senses.en: Unable to support much plant growth.
Producing nothing useful or lacking something important.

ex.en: Only a few bushes grew on the barren hillside.
ex.zh: 贫瘠的山坡上只长着几丛灌木。

ex.en: Unsustainable farming can turn productive fields into barren land, threatening food security and forcing rural communities to relocate.
ex.zh: 不可持续的耕作方式会使良田变成荒地，威胁粮食安全，并迫使农村社区迁移。

tip: barren强调不生长或无产出；bare强调裸露、无遮挡。

senses.en: a market with many small shops or stalls
an event where goods are sold to raise money for charity

ex.en: We bought fragrant spices at the crowded bazaar.
ex.zh: 我们在拥挤的集市上买了香气浓郁的香料。

ex.en: Traditional bazaars can attract tourists while providing local craftspeople with opportunities to sell their products directly.
ex.zh: 传统集市既能吸引游客，也为当地手艺人提供直接销售产品的机会。

tip: 常指多摊位的传统集市，也可指慈善义卖会。

senses.zh: 卧室兼起居室的出租房
senses.en: A rented room used for both living and sleeping.

ex.en: He rented a small bedsit close to the station.
ex.zh: 他在车站附近租了一间卧室兼起居室的小房间。

ex.en: For students with limited budgets, a bedsit may provide affordable accommodation near a university campus.
ex.zh: 对于预算有限的学生，卧室兼起居室的出租房可以提供靠近大学校园的经济住所。

tip: 英国用语，卧室兼起居室，浴室常与他人共用。

senses.en: An act that breaks someone's trust or loyalty.

ex.en: Sharing my private diary felt like a terrible betrayal.
ex.zh: 把我的私人日记给别人看，让我觉得遭到了严重的背叛。

ex.en: Many voters regard broken election promises as a betrayal of the trust they place in political leaders.
ex.zh: 许多选民把不兑现竞选承诺视为对他们给予政治领导人的信任的背叛。

tip: 通常指辜负信任；并非一般意义上的“暴露”。

senses.en: Someone who writes an account of another person's life.

ex.en: The biographer interviewed my grandmother about her childhood friend.
ex.zh: 那位传记作者采访了我祖母，了解她童年好友的往事。

ex.en: A responsible biographer compares multiple sources before drawing conclusions about a historical figure's personal motivations.
ex.zh: 负责任的传记作者会先比较多种资料，再对历史人物的个人动机作出判断。

tip: biographer写他人传记；自传是autobiography。

senses.en: Anger and resentment caused by unfair treatment or disappointment.
A sharp, unpleasant taste like unsweetened coffee.

ex.en: She still feels bitterness about losing her job unfairly.
ex.zh: 她仍对自己遭到不公正解雇感到愤懑。

ex.en: Perceived unfairness in promotion decisions can create lasting bitterness among employees and weaken cooperation within organisations.
ex.zh: 晋升决定若被认为不公平，可能使员工长期心怀怨恨，削弱组织内部的合作。

tip: 通常不可数；既指味觉上的苦，也指内心怨恨。

senses.en: A group of countries or people acting together for shared aims.

ex.en: The councillors formed a bloc to protect local parks.
ex.zh: 这些议员组成了一个联盟，以保护当地公园。

ex.en: A regional trading bloc can strengthen members' bargaining power while reducing barriers to trade between participating countries.
ex.zh: 区域贸易集团可以增强成员的议价能力，同时降低参与国之间的贸易壁垒。

tip: 与block同音；bloc专指共同采取行动的集团。

senses.en: A serious mistake caused by carelessness or poor judgment.
To make a serious or careless mistake.
To move clumsily or without knowing where you are going.

ex.en: I made a blunder and booked the wrong date.
ex.zh: 我犯了个大错，把日期订错了。

ex.en: A major planning blunder can leave communities without adequate transport links for many years.
ex.zh: 重大的规划失误可能使社区多年缺乏完善的交通连接。

tip: 比mistake语气更重，强调因粗心或判断差犯错。

senses.en: confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations
the quality of being visually strong and noticeable

ex.en: Her boldness impressed everyone when she volunteered to lead.
ex.zh: 她自告奋勇担任领队时展现的勇气给大家留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: Addressing climate change requires political boldness, particularly when necessary reforms may initially attract limited public support.
ex.zh: 应对气候变化需要政治勇气，尤其是在必要的改革起初可能缺乏公众支持时。

tip: 可指行动大胆，也可指设计或色彩醒目。

senses.en: Real or genuine, rather than false or pretended.
Made or done honestly, without intending to deceive.

ex.en: An expert confirmed that the painting was bona fide.
ex.zh: 一位专家确认这幅画是真迹。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that financial support reaches bona fide students who genuinely need assistance.
ex.zh: 大学应确保经济资助发放给确有学生身份且真正需要帮助的人。

tip: 较正式，常置于名词前，强调真实或善意。

senses.en: Relating to the final profit or financial outcome.

ex.en: The owner discussed bottom-line results with her accountant.
ex.zh: 店主和她的会计讨论了最终盈利情况。

ex.en: An excessive focus on bottom-line performance may discourage companies from investing in employee development.
ex.zh: 过分关注最终盈利表现可能使企业不愿投资于员工发展。

tip: 连字符形式常作定语；名词写bottom line。

senses.en: Refuse to buy or participate in something as a protest.
An organized refusal to buy or participate as a protest.

ex.en: Local shoppers decided to boycott the store over unfair wages.
ex.zh: 当地购物者因工资待遇不公而决定抵制这家商店。

ex.en: A consumer boycott can pressure companies to improve working conditions throughout their international supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者抵制行动能向企业施压，促使其改善整个国际供应链中的工作条件。

tip: 动词后直接接抵制对象；名词常用a boycott of。

senses.en: Someone who earns money to support a family.

ex.en: My mother was the main bread-earner in our family.
ex.zh: 我母亲曾是家里主要挣钱养家的人。

ex.en: Affordable childcare can help a family's sole bread-earner remain employed while ensuring that children receive appropriate care.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助家中唯一挣钱养家的人继续工作，同时确保孩子得到妥善照顾。

tip: 较少见；日常及考试写作通常用breadwinner。

senses.en: The wide range of things something includes.
The distance from one side of something to the other.

ex.en: The breadth of her interests always surprises her friends.
ex.zh: 她的兴趣之广总让朋友们感到惊讶。

ex.en: Universities should balance breadth of knowledge with opportunities for students to develop expertise in a chosen field.
ex.zh: 大学应兼顾知识的广度，并为学生提供在所选领域发展专长的机会。

tip: breadth强调广度；depth强调深度，二者常并列。

senses.en: Animal reproduction, or controlled reproduction of animals and plants.
Polite behaviour learned through someone's upbringing.

ex.en: We avoid disturbing the birds during the breeding season.
ex.zh: 我们在繁殖季节避免打扰鸟类。

ex.en: Selective breeding can improve crop yields, but it may also reduce genetic diversity within agricultural systems.
ex.zh: 选择性育种能够提高作物产量，但也可能降低农业系统内的遗传多样性。

tip: breeding侧重繁殖或人工育种；breed作名词指品种。

senses.en: the upper edge of a cup, bowl, or other container
the part of a hat extending outward around its base
to be full of liquid or a strong feeling

ex.en: She filled my cup to the brim with tea.
ex.zh: 她把我的杯子倒满了茶。

ex.en: Community centres brimming with activity can strengthen social connections and reduce isolation among older residents.
ex.zh: 活动丰富的社区中心能够加强社会联系，减少老年居民的孤独感。

tip: 满到杯沿用to the brim；充满用brim with。

senses.en: A group of young birds born to the same mother.
To keep thinking unhappily about something.
To sit on eggs or young birds to keep them warm.

ex.en: The duck led her brood across the quiet pond.
ex.zh: 鸭妈妈领着一窝小鸭游过平静的池塘。

ex.en: Students who brood over minor setbacks may find it harder to maintain motivation during demanding courses.
ex.zh: 对小挫折耿耿于怀的学生，可能更难在繁重的课程中保持学习动力。

tip: 作动词表忧思时常接over或on。

senses.en: Large and awkward to carry, move, or store.

ex.en: This bulky suitcase barely fits inside the small cupboard.
ex.zh: 这个大行李箱勉强能塞进那只小柜子。

ex.en: Compact furniture is increasingly popular because bulky items can make small urban apartments feel overcrowded.
ex.zh: 紧凑型家具越来越受欢迎，因为体积庞大的家具会让城市小公寓显得拥挤。

tip: bulky强调体积大、占空间，不一定很重。

senses.en: causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense

ex.en: The extra paperwork became burdensome during our busiest week.
ex.zh: 在我们最忙的那一周，额外的文书工作成了沉重负担。

ex.en: Overly burdensome regulations may discourage small businesses from expanding, even when demand for their products is strong.
ex.zh: 过于繁重的监管规定可能阻碍小企业扩张，即使其产品需求旺盛也是如此。

tip: 多形容任务、费用或规定，不指物体重量。

senses.en: To go around something or avoid a usual step
A road carrying traffic around a town rather than through it
An alternative passage, or surgery creating one for blood flow

ex.en: We took a narrow lane to bypass the village.
ex.zh: 我们走了一条窄路，绕过了村庄。

ex.en: A new bypass could reduce congestion in the town centre but might damage nearby wildlife habitats.
ex.zh: 新建绕城公路可以缓解镇中心的拥堵，但也可能破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。

tip: 作动词直接接宾语：bypass the town。

senses.en: An event causing severe damage, suffering, or distress.

ex.en: The flood was a calamity for the whole village.
ex.zh: 这场洪水给整个村庄带来了灾难。

ex.en: Effective emergency planning can reduce the human and economic costs of a natural calamity.
ex.zh: 有效的应急规划可以减少自然灾难造成的人员损失和经济代价。

tip: 比problem严重得多，常指造成重大损失的灾难。

senses.en: Honest and direct, even about uncomfortable subjects.
Photographed naturally without being asked to pose.

ex.en: Please give me your candid opinion of my cooking.
ex.zh: 请坦率地评价一下我的厨艺。

ex.en: Candid discussions between teachers and parents can help identify problems before they affect academic progress.
ex.zh: 教师与家长坦诚交流，有助于在问题影响学业进步之前发现它们。

tip: 谈人或言论指坦率；谈照片指非摆拍。

senses.en: To approach people and ask for their votes or support.
To ask people about their opinions on a particular issue.

ex.en: Volunteers canvassed the neighbourhood before the local election.
ex.zh: 志愿者在地方选举前到社区挨家挨户拉票。

ex.en: Local authorities should canvass residents' views before introducing major changes to public transport routes and schedules.
ex.zh: 地方政府在大幅调整公共交通路线和时刻表之前，应征求居民意见。

tip: canvass是拉票或征求意见；canvas指帆布。

senses.en: a tiny blood vessel or an extremely narrow tube

senses.zh: 毛细血管的；毛细作用的
senses.en: relating to tiny blood vessels or liquid movement through narrow spaces

ex.en: The diagram shows a capillary beside several skin cells.
ex.zh: 这幅图展示了一条毛细血管及其旁边的几个皮肤细胞。

ex.en: Capillary action allows water to move through narrow spaces in soil, helping moisture reach plant roots.
ex.zh: 毛细作用使水能够穿过土壤中的狭窄空隙，帮助水分到达植物根部。

tip: 复数为capillaries；英美读音的重音位置不同。

senses.en: an economic system based on private ownership and profit

ex.en: We discussed capitalism over coffee after our economics class.
ex.zh: 经济学课后，我们边喝咖啡边讨论资本主义。

ex.en: Critics of capitalism argue that governments should regulate markets to limit inequality and protect vulnerable workers.
ex.zh: 资本主义的批评者认为，政府应监管市场，以限制不平等并保护弱势劳动者。

tip: 不可数名词；capitalist可指资本家或作形容词。

senses.en: Of central importance to a system, belief, or activity.
A senior Catholic official who helps elect the pope.
A North American bird whose male has bright red feathers.

ex.en: Our cardinal rule is to leave nobody behind.
ex.zh: 我们的首要原则是不落下任何人。

ex.en: Protecting patient privacy should remain a cardinal principle when hospitals introduce new digital record systems.
ex.zh: 医院引入新的电子病历系统时，保护患者隐私应始终是一项基本原则。

tip: cardinal number是基数，ordinal number是序数。

senses.en: an animal that eats other animals

ex.en: A tiger is a carnivore with powerful jaws.
ex.zh: 老虎是一种颌部强有力的食肉动物。

ex.en: Protecting large carnivores can help maintain balanced ecosystems by preventing excessive growth in prey populations.
ex.zh: 保护大型食肉动物有助于防止猎物种群过度增长，从而维持生态系统平衡。

tip: carnivore是名词；carnivorous是形容词。

senses.en: A freshwater fish with large scales, often kept in ponds.
To complain repeatedly about small or unimportant faults.

ex.en: We watched a large carp swimming beneath the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条大鲤鱼在桥下游动。

ex.en: Introducing carp into new habitats can disturb aquatic ecosystems by increasing sediment and reducing water clarity.
ex.zh: 将鲤鱼引入新栖息地可能增加水中泥沙、降低水体透明度，从而扰乱水生生态系统。

tip: 鱼名复数通常仍为carp；动词常接at。

senses.en: Strong, flexible tissue found in joints and other body parts.

ex.en: The doctor explained that cartilage cushions my knee joint.
ex.zh: 医生解释说，软骨能缓冲我膝关节受到的冲击。

ex.en: Regular moderate exercise can support joint health, but damaged cartilage often takes a long time to heal.
ex.zh: 经常进行适度运动有助于关节健康，但受损软骨通常需要很长时间才能愈合。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；不是骨头，而是有弹性的组织。

senses.en: a replaceable container holding material needed by a machine
a case containing an explosive charge and usually a bullet

ex.en: I replaced the empty cartridge before printing my homework.
ex.zh: 打印作业前，我换掉了空墨盒。

ex.en: Recycling printer cartridges can reduce plastic waste and recover materials that would otherwise enter landfill sites.
ex.zh: 回收打印机墨盒可以减少塑料垃圾，并回收原本会进入垃圾填埋场的材料。

tip: 核心是可装入设备的筒或盒；打印机语境常指墨盒。

senses.en: A person or thing that triggers or accelerates change.
A substance that speeds up a reaction without being consumed.

ex.en: That conversation became the catalyst for our neighbourhood cleanup.
ex.zh: 那次谈话促成了我们社区的清洁行动。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can act as a catalyst for wider economic growth in disadvantaged regions.
ex.zh: 公共交通投资可以推动欠发达地区更广泛的经济增长。

tip: 比喻推动变化时常用a catalyst for。

senses.en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering

ex.en: The flood was a catastrophe for our small village.
ex.zh: 那场洪水给我们的小村庄带来了一场灾难。

ex.en: Investing in stronger coastal defences could prevent a natural hazard from becoming a humanitarian catastrophe.
ex.zh: 投资建设更坚固的海岸防护设施，可以防止自然灾害演变为人道主义灾难。

tip: 比一般problem严重，常指损失惨重的灾难。

senses.en: A large natural underground cave.

ex.en: Our torches revealed a deep pool inside the cavern.
ex.zh: 手电筒照出了大洞穴里的一潭深水。

ex.en: Tourism within a limestone cavern must be carefully managed to protect fragile formations and underground habitats.
ex.zh: 石灰岩洞穴内的旅游活动必须受到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的岩层构造和地下栖息地。

tip: cavern是大洞穴；酒馆是tavern。

senses.en: Relating to the cells of living organisms.
Using a mobile network divided into local coverage areas.

ex.en: Our teacher showed us cellular structures through a microscope.
ex.zh: 老师让我们通过显微镜观察细胞结构。

ex.en: Research into cellular damage may help scientists develop treatments for diseases associated with ageing.
ex.zh: 对细胞损伤的研究可能帮助科学家开发治疗衰老相关疾病的方法。

tip: 生物学中指细胞的；通信中指蜂窝网络的。

senses.en: an official count of people that collects information about them

ex.en: We completed the census form at our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房餐桌旁填好了人口普查表。

ex.en: Census data help governments plan housing, schools and healthcare services according to changing population needs.
ex.zh: 人口普查数据帮助政府根据不断变化的人口需求规划住房、学校和医疗服务。

tip: census调查全部人口，sample survey只抽样。

senses.en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony

ex.en: The mayor wore a ceremonial robe for the opening.
ex.zh: 市长穿着礼袍出席了开幕仪式。

ex.en: Traditional ceremonial clothing can strengthen cultural identity and connect younger generations with their community's history.
ex.zh: 传统礼仪服饰能够增强文化认同，并让年轻一代与本社区的历史建立联系。

tip: ceremonial重在仪式用途；ceremonious指礼节隆重。

senses.en: A deep, wide opening in rock or the ground.
A major difference separating people, ideas, or situations.

ex.en: We crossed the deep chasm on a narrow bridge.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一座窄桥跨过了深深的峡谷。

ex.en: Unequal access to digital technology has widened the chasm between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获取数字技术的机会不平等，扩大了富裕社区与弱势社区之间的差距。

tip: ch读/k/；比喻巨大差距时常用chasm between。

senses.en: Continuing for a long time, especially a medical condition

senses.zh: 长期存在的；反复发生的
senses.en: Persisting or recurring over a long period

ex.en: Gentle swimming helps her manage her chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 舒缓的游泳运动有助于她控制慢性背痛。

ex.en: Chronic staff shortages can reduce the quality of healthcare and increase pressure on existing medical workers.
ex.zh: 长期人员短缺会降低医疗服务质量，并增加现有医护人员的压力。

tip: 疾病语境中chronic指慢性，acute指急性。

senses.en: The order of events in time, or a record showing it.
The study of when past events happened.

ex.en: These family photos helped us establish the chronology.
ex.zh: 这些家庭照片帮助我们确定了事情发生的先后顺序。

ex.en: Establishing an accurate chronology allows historians to examine how environmental changes influenced the development of early settlements.
ex.zh: 建立准确的事件时间序列，有助于历史学家研究环境变化如何影响早期聚落的发展。

tip: chronology是名词；按时间顺序用chronologically。

senses.zh: 柑橘类果树；柑橘类水果
senses.en: Trees producing fruits such as oranges and lemons, or their fruits.
Relating to fruits such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruit.

ex.en: We squeezed fresh citrus juice over the salad.
ex.zh: 我们在沙拉上挤了一些新鲜的柑橘类果汁。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may affect citrus production by increasing water demand and exposing orchards to new pests.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能增加需水量，并使果园面临新的虫害，从而影响柑橘生产。

tip: citrus是总称，包括橙、柠檬、葡萄柚等。

senses.en: Loud noise or strong public demands
To demand something loudly or insistently

ex.en: The children clamored for another story before bedtime.
ex.zh: 睡觉前，孩子们吵着要再听一个故事。

ex.en: Public clamor for cleaner air has encouraged local authorities to invest in more reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 公众要求改善空气质量的强烈呼声，推动地方政府投资建设更可靠的公共交通。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为clamour。要求某物用clamor for。

senses.en: The removal of unwanted objects or material from a place
Official permission to do something or enter a place
The sale of remaining goods at reduced prices

ex.en: The garden clearance took us most of Saturday.
ex.zh: 清理花园花了我们周六大半天的时间。

ex.en: Large-scale forest clearance can destroy wildlife habitats and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 大规模森林清除会破坏野生动物栖息地，并增加水土流失的风险。

tip: clearance sale是清仓促销；清关用customs clearance。

senses.en: To close your hands or press your teeth together tightly.

ex.en: Arun clenched his fists as the cold wind blew.
ex.zh: 寒风吹来，阿伦握紧了双拳。

ex.en: People under prolonged stress may clench their teeth during sleep, potentially causing pain in the jaw.
ex.zh: 长期承受压力的人可能在睡眠中咬紧牙齿，从而引发下颌疼痛。

tip: clench指握紧或咬紧；clin​​ch才可指赢得、敲定。

senses.en: Forming the most exciting or important part of something.

ex.en: Everyone held their breath during the film's climactic scene.
ex.zh: 电影演到高潮时，所有人都屏住了呼吸。

ex.en: The novel's climactic confrontation reveals how social expectations can shape personal decisions and family relationships.
ex.zh: 小说中达到高潮的冲突揭示了社会期望如何影响个人决定和家庭关系。

tip: 勿与climatic（气候的）混淆。

senses.en: The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.

ex.en: My grandparents first experienced coeducation at their village school.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母在村里的学校首次接受了男女同校教育。

ex.en: Supporters of coeducation argue that learning together helps boys and girls develop mutual respect.
ex.zh: 支持男女同校教育的人认为，共同学习有助于男孩和女孩培养相互尊重的态度。

tip: 不可数名词；形容词形式为coeducational。

senses.en: A tooth on a gear, or the gear itself
Someone with a small role in a large organisation

ex.en: A broken cog stopped the old clock from working.
ex.zh: 一个断裂的轮齿让那座老钟停止了运转。

ex.en: Employees may lose motivation if they feel like a cog in a machine rather than valued contributors.
ex.zh: 如果员工觉得自己只是机器中的小零件，而非受到重视的贡献者，就可能失去动力。

tip: a cog in the machine比喻机构中的小角色。

senses.en: Related to mental processes such as learning, remembering, and understanding.

ex.en: These puzzles help my grandmother keep her cognitive skills sharp.
ex.zh: 这些益智游戏帮助我祖母保持敏锐的认知能力。

ex.en: Regular physical activity may support cognitive development in children and help older adults maintain their memory.
ex.zh: 规律的身体活动可能促进儿童认知发展，并帮助老年人保持记忆力。

tip: 常修饰ability、development等，侧重思维和记忆。

senses.en: The quality of ideas fitting together clearly and logically.

ex.en: Your story needs more coherence between its different parts.
ex.zh: 你故事中的各个部分需要衔接得更连贯。

ex.en: Clear paragraph structure improves the coherence of an essay and helps readers follow complex arguments.
ex.zh: 清晰的段落结构能增强文章的连贯性，帮助读者理解复杂的论证。

tip: 侧重逻辑连贯；cohesion侧重语言或结构衔接。

senses.en: The strength of connection that keeps a group together
The way parts of a text connect through language

ex.en: Our weekly team lunches helped build cohesion at work.
ex.zh: 我们每周的团队午餐有助于增强工作中的凝聚力。

ex.en: Shared public spaces can strengthen social cohesion by encouraging regular interaction between residents from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 共享公共空间能促进不同背景的居民经常交流，从而增强社会凝聚力。

tip: 写作中cohesion指语言衔接，coherence指逻辑连贯。

senses.zh: 有凝聚力的；紧密结合的
senses.en: united or closely connected as a whole

ex.en: Regular practice helped us become a more cohesive team.
ex.zh: 定期练习帮助我们成为一支更有凝聚力的队伍。

ex.en: Shared public spaces can help build cohesive communities by encouraging interaction among people from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 共享公共空间可以促进不同背景的人交流，从而帮助建设有凝聚力的社区。

tip: cohesive强调紧密结合；coherent强调条理清楚。

senses.en: to wind into a series of circles or rings
a series of connected loops in wire, rope, or tubing

ex.en: Please coil the rope before putting it away.
ex.zh: 请先把绳子盘好再收起来。

ex.en: Engineers coil long pipes beneath buildings so that heat can be transferred efficiently from the ground.
ex.zh: 工程师在建筑物下方盘绕长管道，以便高效地传递地下热量。

tip: 作动词可及物或不及物，强调绕成圈或螺旋。

senses.en: Control of another territory and its people by a country

ex.en: The museum explores how colonialism changed life on the island.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆展示了殖民统治如何改变岛上的生活。

ex.en: The legacy of colonialism continues to influence language, economic structures, and political institutions in many countries.
ex.zh: 殖民主义的历史影响至今仍体现在许多国家的语言、经济结构和政治制度中。

col: 殖民主义的历史遗留影响
tip: 通常不可数；colony指殖民地，非殖民主义。

senses.en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.

ex.en: The stove needs enough air for efficient combustion.
ex.zh: 炉子需要充足的空气才能高效燃烧。

ex.en: The combustion of fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide, contributing significantly to the rise in global temperatures.
ex.zh: 化石燃料燃烧会释放二氧化碳，是全球气温上升的重要原因之一。

tip: 通常不可数，是burning的科技语体表达。

senses.en: To honour a person or event by remembering them publicly

ex.en: We planted a tree to commemorate our grandfather's life.
ex.zh: 我们种了一棵树，纪念祖父的一生。

ex.en: Public ceremonies commemorate historical events and help younger generations understand the experiences that shaped their communities.
ex.zh: 公共纪念仪式缅怀历史事件，帮助年轻一代理解塑造其社区的经历。

tip: 直接接纪念对象；不一定含有庆祝的喜悦。

senses.en: to begin something or start happening

ex.en: The evening concert will commence after a short welcome.
ex.zh: 简短的欢迎致辞后，晚间音乐会将开始。

ex.en: Construction of the new railway will commence once the environmental assessment has been completed.
ex.zh: 环境评估完成后，新铁路的建设将启动。

tip: 比start正式；可接名词或动名词。

senses.en: The beginning of something, especially an official activity
A ceremony celebrating students completing their studies in the United States

ex.en: We heard a whistle at the commencement of play.
ex.zh: 比赛开始时，我们听到了一声哨响。

ex.en: Environmental assessments should be completed before the commencement of construction to minimise potential damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 施工开始前应完成环境评估，以尽量减少对当地生态系统的潜在破坏。

tip: 表示“开始”较正式；美式英语中也指毕业典礼。

senses.en: to praise someone or something, often publicly
to recommend someone or something as worthy of consideration

ex.en: The coach commended Lina for helping her teammates.
ex.zh: 教练表扬莉娜帮助了队友。

ex.en: Inspectors commended the school for providing additional support to students with different learning needs.
ex.zh: 督察人员赞扬该校为有不同学习需求的学生提供额外支持。

tip: commend是称赞；command是命令，注意拼写。

senses.en: an official responsible for a public service or commission

ex.en: The commissioner visited our neighbourhood to discuss road safety.
ex.zh: 这位专员来到我们社区讨论道路安全问题。

ex.en: An independent commissioner should investigate public complaints and ensure that government agencies treat citizens fairly.
ex.zh: 独立专员应调查公众投诉，并确保政府机构公平对待公民。

tip: 通常指负有特定公共职责的官员，不泛指所有委员。

senses.en: Happening or found often enough to seem ordinary.
Something ordinary, or a familiar statement lacking originality.

ex.en: Electric bikes are commonplace in our neighbourhood now.
ex.zh: 电动自行车如今在我们社区很常见。

ex.en: Remote working has become commonplace in many industries, changing how companies organise their offices.
ex.zh: 远程办公在许多行业已变得普遍，改变了企业安排办公空间的方式。

tip: 多指常见到不足为奇，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: Showing practical judgment based on ordinary experience.

ex.en: Taking an umbrella was a commonsense decision in this weather.
ex.zh: 这种天气带伞是个明智的决定。

ex.en: Simple commonsense measures, such as improving street lighting, can make residential areas safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明等简单而符合常识的措施，可以让住宅区的行人更加安全。

tip: 形容词也写作common-sense；名词common sense分写。

senses.en: A politically organised community, especially one governed for public benefit.
An association of independent countries, mostly formerly under British rule.

ex.en: The islanders established a commonwealth with an elected council.
ex.zh: 岛民建立了一个由民选议会治理的政治共同体。

ex.en: Members of the Commonwealth cooperate on education and development while maintaining their own independent governments.
ex.zh: 英联邦成员在教育和发展领域开展合作，同时保有各自独立的政府。

tip: 指英联邦时首字母大写，通常与the连用。

senses.en: a group living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities

ex.en: They live in a commune and grow vegetables together.
ex.zh: 他们住在一个共同生活的群体中，一起种菜。

ex.en: Living in a commune can reduce individual expenses, but shared decision-making requires patience and effective communication.
ex.zh: 公社生活可以减少个人开支，但共同决策需要耐心和有效沟通。

tip: 名词指共同生活群体；动词 commune with 指心灵交流。

senses.en: Able to work or exist together without problems
Having personalities or interests that allow a good relationship

ex.en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
ex.zh: 这个充电器兼容我们的两台平板电脑。

ex.en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励更清洁的生产方式和负责任的资源利用，经济增长就能与环境保护并行。

tip: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

senses.en: the act of following a rule, law, or request

ex.en: The inspector checked our kitchen for compliance with hygiene rules.
ex.zh: 检查员查看了我们的厨房是否符合卫生规定。

ex.en: Regular inspections can improve compliance with environmental regulations and reduce pollution from industrial facilities.
ex.zh: 定期检查可以促进企业遵守环境法规，减少工业设施造成的污染。

tip: 通常不可数；表示遵守某规定时用compliance with。

senses.en: made by combining different parts or materials
something made from several different parts or materials

ex.en: Our new garden bench is made from composite material.
ex.zh: 我们的新花园长椅是用复合材料制成的。

ex.en: Lightweight composite materials can reduce fuel consumption by making aircraft lighter without significantly compromising their strength.
ex.zh: 轻质复合材料能够减轻飞机重量，同时不明显损害其强度，从而降低燃料消耗。

tip: 强调由不同部分组合而成，常修饰material或image。

senses.en: to have particular people or things as parts
to be the parts or members that form something

ex.en: The gift set comprises soap, lotion, and a towel.
ex.zh: 这套礼盒包含香皂、乳液和一条毛巾。

ex.en: The proposed transport network will comprise bus routes and cycle lanes connecting residential areas with employment centres.
ex.zh: 拟建的交通网络将由连接住宅区与就业中心的公交线路和自行车道组成。

tip: 最稳妥结构：整体comprises部分，不加of。

senses.en: The process of finding an answer using mathematics or computers.

ex.en: A quick computation showed we could afford the sofa.
ex.zh: 简单算了一下，我们发现买得起那张沙发。

ex.en: Advances in computation allow researchers to analyse climate data and produce increasingly accurate weather forecasts.
ex.zh: 计算技术的进步使研究人员能够分析气候数据，并作出日益准确的天气预报。

tip: 比calculation更正式，常用于数学和计算机领域。

senses.en: To calculate an amount or result, often using a computer.

ex.en: This app computes the cost of our weekly shopping.
ex.zh: 这个应用程序计算我们每周购物的费用。

ex.en: Researchers compute average temperatures from satellite data to assess long-term changes in the global climate.
ex.zh: 研究人员根据卫星数据计算平均气温，以评估全球气候的长期变化。

tip: 比calculate更正式，常用于计算机或数学语境。

senses.en: the introduction of computers to perform tasks or manage information

ex.en: Computerization means we no longer sort these files by hand.
ex.zh: 实现计算机化后，我们不再手工整理这些档案。

ex.en: The computerization of hospital records can improve efficiency, but it also requires strong safeguards for patient privacy.
ex.zh: 医院档案计算机化可以提高效率，但也需要有力措施保护患者隐私。

tip: 英式也写computerisation；通常作不可数名词。

senses.en: To admit something is true, often unwillingly
To give up something or allow it after resistance
To accept that you have lost a contest

ex.en: He finally conceded that my route was much quicker.
ex.zh: 他终于承认我选的路线快得多。

ex.en: Although critics concede that tourism creates jobs, they argue that its environmental costs are often overlooked.
ex.zh: 尽管批评者承认旅游业创造就业，他们仍认为其环境代价常被忽视。

tip: 常含原本反对、后来不得不承认的意味。

senses.en: Possible to imagine or believe.

ex.en: We searched every conceivable place for the missing keys.
ex.zh: 我们找遍了所有能想到的地方，寻找丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: It is conceivable that advances in renewable energy could significantly reduce global dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的进步有可能显著降低全球对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 表示能设想或有可能，不等于很可能发生。

senses.en: to form an idea or imagine something
to become pregnant or cause a baby to begin developing

ex.en: She conceived the idea while walking through the park.
ex.zh: 她在公园散步时想出了这个主意。

ex.en: Urban planners must conceive new ways of accommodating population growth without sacrificing green spaces or affordable housing.
ex.zh: 城市规划者必须构思新方法，在不牺牲绿地或保障性住房的前提下应对人口增长。

tip: conceive an idea指构思；conceive of指设想。

senses.en: an idea or understanding of what something is like
the process in which an egg is fertilised, beginning pregnancy
the formation of a plan or idea

ex.en: His conception of a perfect holiday involves no phones.
ex.zh: 在他看来，完美的假期是不碰手机的假期。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can broaden children's conception of nature beyond what they learn in classrooms.
ex.zh: 接触绿地能拓宽儿童对自然的认识，使其不局限于课堂所学。

tip: conception of指对事物的理解；也可表示受孕。

senses.zh: 协同一致的；共同筹划的
senses.en: Planned and carried out together to achieve a shared goal.
Involving determined effort directed towards a particular goal.

ex.en: Our concerted efforts finally cleared the garden of rubbish.
ex.zh: 我们齐心协力，终于清除了花园里的垃圾。

ex.en: Reducing urban air pollution requires concerted action from local authorities, transport providers, businesses and residents.
ex.zh: 减少城市空气污染需要地方政府、交通服务商、企业和居民采取协同行动。

tip: 常修饰effort或action，强调协同或集中全力。

senses.en: proving something clearly and leaving no reasonable doubt

ex.en: The camera footage provided conclusive proof of what happened.
ex.zh: 摄像机拍下的画面为事情的经过提供了确凿证据。

ex.en: Researchers need conclusive evidence before recommending major changes to national policies on childhood nutrition.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议大幅调整国家儿童营养政策之前，需要获得确凿证据。

tip: 常修饰evidence或proof，不等于“最后的”。

senses.en: to agree with someone or share the same opinion

ex.en: I concur with your suggestion to leave before lunch.
ex.zh: 我同意你午饭前出发的建议。

ex.en: Most researchers concur that investment in early childhood education brings substantial benefits to society.
ex.zh: 大多数研究人员一致认为，投资幼儿教育能为社会带来显著益处。

tip: 正式用词，常用concur with某人或concur that从句。

senses.en: Happening or existing at the same time

ex.en: Two concurrent meetings meant I had to choose one.
ex.zh: 两个会议同时举行，我只能选择参加其中一个。

ex.en: Concurrent improvements in housing and public transport can make urban development more inclusive and sustainable.
ex.zh: 同步改善住房和公共交通，可以使城市发展更具包容性和可持续性。

tip: 强调时间重叠；表示“与…同时”可用concurrent with。

senses.en: To express strong disapproval of someone or something.
To officially give someone a severe punishment.
To officially declare a building unsafe to use.

ex.en: Our neighbours condemned the dumping of rubbish beside the river.
ex.zh: 邻居们谴责了在河边倾倒垃圾的行为。

ex.en: Environmental organisations condemn illegal logging because it destroys wildlife habitats and threatens the livelihoods of local communities.
ex.zh: 环保组织谴责非法伐木，因为它破坏野生动物栖息地，并威胁当地社区的生计。

tip: 词尾n不发音；别与表示“冷凝”的condense混淆。

senses.en: An expression of strong disapproval
An official judgment imposing punishment or declaring something unsafe

ex.en: His cruel remarks drew condemnation from everyone at dinner.
ex.zh: 他刻薄的话遭到了所有同桌用餐者的谴责。

ex.en: The destruction of protected forests has attracted widespread condemnation from environmental groups and local communities.
ex.zh: 破坏受保护森林的行为引起了环保团体和当地社区的广泛谴责。

tip: 常用condemnation of sth；比criticism语气更强。

senses.en: Sympathy expressed to someone whose relative or friend has died.

ex.en: Our neighbours sent a heartfelt message of condolence.
ex.zh: 邻居们送来了真挚的慰问。

ex.en: Public expressions of condolence can help bereaved families feel supported by their wider community.
ex.zh: 公开表达哀思可以让丧亲家庭感受到整个社区的支持。

tip: 常用复数：offer condolences to someone。

senses.en: Discuss something with others before making a decision.
Officially give someone an honour, right, or benefit.

ex.en: The coaches conferred quietly before choosing the final team.
ex.zh: 教练们低声商议后才确定最终的队伍阵容。

ex.en: Universities often confer honorary degrees on individuals who have made outstanding contributions to science or public service.
ex.zh: 大学常向在科学或公共服务领域作出杰出贡献的人士授予荣誉学位。

tip: 商议用confer with；授予用confer sth on sb。

senses.en: to follow rules or meet required standards
to behave as others in a group expect

ex.en: These new helmets conform to the latest safety standards.
ex.zh: 这些新头盔符合最新的安全标准。

ex.en: Pressure to conform can discourage young people from expressing original ideas or questioning established traditions.
ex.zh: 要求随大流的压力可能使年轻人不愿表达独创想法，也不敢质疑既有传统。

tip: 常用conform to rules或standards，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.

ex.en: Our art teacher encourages creativity rather than strict conformity.
ex.zh: 我们的美术老师鼓励创造，而不是一味墨守成规。

ex.en: Strong pressure for conformity in schools may discourage students from questioning established ideas and developing independent judgement.
ex.zh: 学校里强烈的从众压力可能阻碍学生质疑既有观念和培养独立判断力。

tip: in conformity with表示符合或遵照某规则。

senses.en: someone who takes control of a place through military force

ex.en: The museum displayed a conqueror's helmet beside his sword.
ex.zh: 博物馆里，一位征服者的头盔陈列在他的剑旁。

ex.en: A conqueror may impose new laws and customs, profoundly changing the cultural identity of local communities.
ex.zh: 征服者可能强行推行新的法律和习俗，深刻改变当地社区的文化认同。

tip: 指通过武力征服的人，不泛指比赛获胜者。

senses.en: the act of taking control of a country by force
a place brought under control through military force

ex.en: The castle fell after months of fighting and conquest.
ex.zh: 经过数月的战斗与征服，这座城堡陷落了。

ex.en: Military conquest often reshaped trade networks and introduced new languages to regions under foreign rule.
ex.zh: 军事征服往往重塑贸易网络，并将新语言带入受外来统治的地区。

tip: 表示征服行为可不可数；指征服的领土时可数。

senses.en: Careful to do duties thoroughly and correctly

ex.en: Our conscientious neighbour checks our plants every morning.
ex.zh: 我们认真负责的邻居每天早晨都会查看我们的植物。

ex.en: Conscientious employees contribute to workplace safety by following procedures carefully and reporting potential hazards promptly.
ex.zh: 尽责的员工通过认真遵守规程并及时报告潜在危险，为工作场所安全作出贡献。

tip: conscientious是认真负责的；conscious是有意识的。

senses.en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.

ex.en: The nurse conscientiously checked every item in the kit.
ex.zh: 护士认真负责地检查了工具包里的每件物品。

ex.en: Teachers who conscientiously review individual progress can identify learning difficulties before students fall significantly behind.
ex.zh: 认真评估每个学生进步情况的教师，能够在学生明显落后之前发现学习困难。

tip: 强调责任心与认真态度，不只是动作小心。

senses.en: following one after another without any interruption

ex.en: It has rained for five consecutive days this week.
ex.zh: 这周已经连续下了五天雨。

ex.en: Several consecutive years of low rainfall have reduced agricultural output and increased pressure on regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 连续数年的降雨偏少导致农业产量下降，并加大了地区供水压力。

tip: 强调一个接一个、中间无间断，常修饰天数或次数。

senses.en: General agreement among members of a group.

ex.en: We finally reached a consensus on where to eat.
ex.zh: 我们终于就去哪里吃饭达成了共识。

ex.en: There is a broad consensus among researchers that early childhood education can improve children's future learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 研究人员普遍认为，幼儿教育能改善儿童未来的学习成效。

tip: 常用reach a consensus on；共识未必全票一致。

senses.en: A batch of goods sent to a person or place.
An arrangement where sellers pay suppliers only after goods sell.

ex.en: A consignment of fresh oranges arrived at the shop.
ex.zh: 一批新鲜橙子运到了店里。

ex.en: Delays in inspecting a consignment of medical equipment can disrupt essential services in remote communities.
ex.zh: 一批医疗设备的检验延误，可能会影响偏远社区的基本服务。

tip: on consignment指寄售，卖出后再向供货方付款。

senses.en: comfort received when you feel sad or disappointed
someone or something that makes disappointment easier to bear

ex.en: After losing the match, she found consolation in music.
ex.zh: 输掉比赛后，她从音乐中获得了慰藉。

ex.en: For workers facing unemployment, emotional support offers some consolation, but practical assistance remains essential for long-term recovery.
ex.zh: 对于面临失业的劳动者，情感支持能带来些许安慰，但实际援助对长期恢复仍至关重要。

tip: 安慰本身不可数；具体的安慰之事可用a consolation。

senses.en: To make an achievement, position, or skill stronger.
To combine separate things into a single effective whole.

ex.en: I review my notes each evening to consolidate my learning.
ex.zh: 我每晚复习笔记，以巩固所学内容。

ex.en: Regular practical exercises help students consolidate their knowledge and apply theoretical concepts to unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 定期的实践练习有助于学生巩固知识，并将理论概念应用于陌生情境。

tip: 既可指巩固已有成果，也可指合并多个部分。

senses.en: easy to notice because of being unusual or different

ex.en: Her yellow umbrella was conspicuous among the black ones.
ex.zh: 在一片黑色雨伞中，她的黄色雨伞格外显眼。

ex.en: Conspicuous consumption can encourage unnecessary spending as people seek to display their wealth through expensive possessions.
ex.zh: 炫耀性消费可能助长不必要的开支，因为人们试图通过昂贵物品展示财富。

col: 因缺失而格外引人注意
tip: 强调容易被注意到，不一定表示重要。

senses.en: a person living in an area represented by an elected official
one of the parts or substances that form something
forming part of a larger whole

ex.en: A constituent asked her local representative about the closed library.
ex.zh: 一位选区居民向当地民意代表询问图书馆关闭的事。

ex.en: Elected representatives should consult their constituents before supporting policies that significantly affect local housing and public transport.
ex.zh: 民选代表在支持对当地住房和公共交通有重大影响的政策之前，应征询选区居民的意见。

tip: 选民义可含未投票的选区居民；成分义近component。

senses.en: Something that limits what you can do.
Control that prevents free or natural behaviour.

ex.en: Our main constraint is the size of the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们的主要限制是厨房的大小。

ex.en: Financial constraints prevent many local authorities from investing adequately in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 财政限制使许多地方政府无法充分投资于可靠的公共交通。

tip: 常用复数constraints；对……的限制用on。

senses.en: To understand a statement or action in a particular way.

ex.en: Please don't construe my silence as a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 请不要把我的沉默理解为不感兴趣。

ex.en: A failure to consult local residents may be construed as disregard for their concerns about urban development.
ex.zh: 未征询当地居民的意见，可能被理解为漠视他们对城市发展的担忧。

tip: 常用construe A as B，表示“把A理解为B”。

senses.en: An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests

ex.en: The consul helped us after we lost our passports.
ex.zh: 我们丢失护照后，领事给我们提供了帮助。

ex.en: A consul may support citizens facing difficulties overseas and help strengthen commercial links between countries.
ex.zh: 领事可以为在海外遇到困难的本国公民提供支持，并帮助加强国家间的商业联系。

tip: consul是领事；consulate是领事馆，勿混淆。

senses.en: make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful substances

ex.en: Dirty hands can contaminate food while you cook.
ex.zh: 做饭时，不干净的手可能会污染食物。

ex.en: Industrial chemicals can contaminate groundwater, threatening both agricultural production and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 工业化学品可能污染地下水，威胁农业生产及附近社区居民的健康。

tip: 常用be contaminated with表示被某物污染。

senses.en: the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something
the act of considering a possible future action

ex.en: He sat by the lake in quiet contemplation.
ex.zh: 他坐在湖边，静静地沉思。

ex.en: Public gardens offer urban residents valuable opportunities for quiet contemplation away from the pressures of daily life.
ex.zh: 公共花园为城市居民提供宝贵的机会，让他们远离日常生活的压力，静心沉思。

tip: 通常不可数；强调安静深思，不一定是痛苦思索。

senses.en: To argue that something is true.
To struggle with a difficulty or challenging situation.
To compete for something against other people.

ex.en: I contend that our kitchen needs a bigger table.
ex.zh: 我认为我们的厨房需要一张更大的桌子。

ex.en: Some researchers contend that affordable public transport is more effective than road expansion in reducing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 一些研究者认为，在缓解城市拥堵方面，价格合理的公共交通比扩建道路更有效。

tip: contend that表主张；with接困难；for接争夺目标。

senses.en: Relating to or required by a legal agreement.

ex.en: Fixing the heating is the landlord's contractual responsibility.
ex.zh: 修好暖气是房东按合同应承担的责任。

ex.en: Employers should explain contractual obligations clearly so that workers understand their rights before accepting a position.
ex.zh: 雇主应清楚说明合同义务，让劳动者在接受职位前了解自己的权利。

tip: 强调合同规定的权利或义务，常置于名词前。

senses.en: To be inconsistent with another statement, fact, or piece of evidence.
To say that someone else's statement is wrong.

ex.en: Your muddy shoes contradict your claim about staying indoors.
ex.zh: 你说自己一直待在室内，但你鞋上的泥可不是这么回事。

ex.en: Recent findings contradict the assumption that longer working hours necessarily lead to higher levels of productivity.
ex.zh: 近期研究结果与“工作时间越长，生产效率必然越高”的假设相矛盾。

tip: 及物动词，直接接人或说法；无需加with。

senses.en: A difference between statements or facts that cannot both be true
The act of saying that a statement is wrong

ex.en: I noticed a contradiction between his two explanations.
ex.zh: 我注意到他的两次解释互相矛盾。

ex.en: There is a clear contradiction between promoting sustainable transport and reducing investment in local bus services.
ex.zh: 提倡可持续交通与减少对当地公交服务的投资之间存在明显矛盾。

tip: 常用a contradiction between A and B。

senses.en: to manage to do something difficult or unexpected
to create or arrange something through clever planning

ex.en: We contrived to fit every suitcase into the tiny car.
ex.zh: 我们设法把所有行李箱都塞进了那辆小汽车。

ex.en: Despite limited funding, the research team contrived to develop an affordable device for monitoring water quality.
ex.zh: 尽管资金有限，研究团队仍设法开发出一种价格低廉的水质监测设备。

tip: contrive to do表示设法做到；contrived常指刻意不自然。

senses.en: Familiar with a subject and able to discuss it

ex.en: Our new guide is conversant with the area's history.
ex.zh: 我们的新导游熟悉这一地区的历史。

ex.en: Graduates entering the technology sector should be conversant with current debates about privacy and data protection.
ex.zh: 进入科技行业的毕业生应熟悉当前有关隐私与数据保护的讨论。

tip: 常用be conversant with，表示熟悉某领域，并非有交情。

senses.en: used to introduce an opposite situation or relationship

ex.en: I love busy cities; conversely, my sister prefers quiet villages.
ex.zh: 我喜欢热闹的城市；相反，我姐姐更喜欢安静的村庄。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can reduce car use; conversely, poor services may encourage greater dependence on private vehicles.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以减少汽车使用；反过来，服务欠佳可能使人们更加依赖私家车。

tip: 用于引出相反情况，不是一般性的补充转折。

senses.en: Friendly and polite, often in a formal situation.
A sweet concentrated fruit drink usually diluted with water.

ex.en: Our new neighbours gave us a cordial welcome.
ex.zh: 新邻居热情地欢迎了我们。

ex.en: Maintaining cordial relations between neighbouring countries can encourage cooperation on trade and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 邻国之间保持友好关系有助于促进贸易和环境保护方面的合作。

tip: 形容友好态度较正式；名词在英国常指浓缩果饮。

senses.en: a large military unit or branch with particular duties
an organized group of people doing the same specialized work

ex.en: My cousin joined the medical corps after finishing university.
ex.zh: 我表亲大学毕业后加入了军队医疗部队。

ex.en: The diplomatic corps can support international cooperation by maintaining communication between governments during periods of tension.
ex.zh: 外交使团可以在紧张时期维持政府之间的沟通，从而支持国际合作。

tip: 单复数拼写相同；单数不读ps，复数词尾读/z/。

senses.en: Written communication between people, or the messages they exchange.
A close similarity or connection between two things.

ex.en: She keeps her correspondence with her cousin in a drawer.
ex.zh: 她把与表亲的往来信件放在抽屉里。

ex.en: Historical correspondence can reveal how ordinary families experienced social changes that official records describe only briefly.
ex.zh: 历史上的往来信件能揭示普通家庭如何经历官方记录仅简略提及的社会变迁。

tip: 表示往来信件时不可数；与某人通信用with。

senses.en: To gradually damage material chemically, or become damaged this way.
To gradually weaken something such as trust or confidence.

ex.en: Salt water has corroded the metal hinges on our gate.
ex.zh: 盐水腐蚀了我们大门上的金属铰链。

ex.en: A lack of transparency can corrode public trust in institutions and reduce participation in democratic processes.
ex.zh: 缺乏透明度会逐渐损害公众对机构的信任，并降低公众参与民主进程的意愿。

tip: 可及物也可不及物；rust主要指铁生锈。

senses.zh: 多国文化交融的；国际化的
senses.en: Including people and cultural influences from many different countries.

senses.zh: 见多识广的；具有国际视野的
senses.en: Familiar with and comfortable in different countries and cultures.

ex.en: Our cosmopolitan neighbourhood has restaurants serving food from many countries.
ex.zh: 我们这个国际化社区有供应各国美食的餐馆。

ex.en: Cosmopolitan cities can encourage cultural exchange by creating shared spaces where residents from different backgrounds regularly interact.
ex.zh: 国际化城市可以通过创建共享空间，让不同背景的居民经常交流，从而促进文化交流。

tip: 常形容城市或人，强调多元文化，而非单指全球范围。

senses.en: A different offer made in response to an earlier offer.

ex.en: The seller rejected our price and made a counter-offer.
ex.zh: 卖家拒绝了我们出的价格，并提出了还价。

ex.en: Employers may make a counter-offer when skilled employees announce plans to accept a position elsewhere.
ex.zh: 当技术熟练的员工宣布打算另谋职位时，雇主可能提出新的待遇条件以挽留他们。

tip: 可写作counteroffer；不仅指还价，也指修改条件。

senses.en: Polite and respectful towards other people.

ex.en: The courteous driver waited while I found my ticket.
ex.zh: 那位有礼貌的司机耐心等我找到车票。

ex.en: Courteous communication between healthcare staff and patients can improve trust and make medical appointments less stressful.
ex.zh: 医护人员与患者之间礼貌的沟通可以增进信任，减轻就诊带来的压力。

tip: 比polite更正式；对某人有礼貌用to。

senses.en: A small bed for a baby that can rock.
The place where something important first developed.
Hold someone or something gently and protectively.

ex.en: The baby slept peacefully in a wooden cradle.
ex.zh: 宝宝在木摇篮里安静地睡着。

ex.en: The region is often described as a cradle of agriculture because of its early farming settlements.
ex.zh: 由于拥有早期的农耕聚落，这一地区常被称为农业的发源地。

tip: the cradle of 可比喻某种文明或活动的发源地。

senses.en: Skill in making things, especially carefully by hand.

ex.en: The handmade chair shows beautiful craftsmanship in every joint.
ex.zh: 这把手工椅子的每一处接合都展现出精湛工艺。

ex.en: Preserving traditional craftsmanship can support local economies while protecting cultural knowledge passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 保护传统手艺既能支持地方经济，也能保护代代相传的文化知识。

tip: 不可数名词，强调制作技艺或成品的工艺水平。

senses.en: To severely damage something's ability to function
To cause a serious injury that limits someone's movement

ex.en: The power cut crippled our heating system all evening.
ex.zh: 停电让我们的供暖系统瘫痪了整整一个晚上。

ex.en: A prolonged drought can cripple agricultural production, reducing rural incomes and increasing food prices across the country.
ex.zh: 长期干旱可能重创农业生产，降低农村收入，并推高全国食品价格。

tip: 名词指人有冒犯性；动词常指经济或系统受重创。

senses.en: A standard used to judge something or make a decision.

ex.en: Price was my main criterion when choosing a bicycle.
ex.zh: 选自行车时，价格是我的主要衡量标准。

ex.en: Environmental impact should be a key criterion when governments assess proposals for new transport infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府评估新交通基础设施提案时，应将环境影响作为重要标准。

tip: 单数criterion，复数criteria；不能说a criteria。

senses.en: A powered leisure boat with space for sleeping.
A large, fast military ship.
A police car used to patrol an area.

ex.en: We spent the weekend aboard a small cabin cruiser.
ex.zh: 我们在一艘小型舱式游艇上度过了周末。

ex.en: The growing popularity of holidays aboard a cruiser has increased demand for moorings along inland waterways.
ex.zh: 乘坐舱式游艇度假日益流行，使内陆水道沿线的泊位需求有所增加。

tip: 大型邮轮通常叫cruise ship，不叫cruiser。

senses.en: An art style showing subjects through geometric shapes and multiple viewpoints.

ex.en: We explored cubism by painting faces with overlapping geometric shapes.
ex.zh: 我们用重叠的几何图形画人脸，探索立体主义风格。

ex.en: Cubism challenged traditional artistic representation by presenting multiple viewpoints within a single image rather than imitating natural appearances.
ex.zh: 立体主义在同一幅图像中呈现多个视角，而非模仿自然外观，从而挑战了传统艺术表现方式。

tip: 通常不可数；cubist 可指立体派艺术家或作形容词。

senses.en: To reach a final result or highest point after gradual development

ex.en: Weeks of rehearsals culminated in a wonderful evening performance.
ex.zh: 经过数周排练，大家最终献上了一场精彩的晚间演出。

ex.en: Years of public consultation culminated in a comprehensive transport plan designed to reduce congestion and improve accessibility.
ex.zh: 多年的公众咨询最终促成了一项旨在缓解拥堵、改善交通可达性的综合交通规划。

tip: 常用 culminate in＋结果，强调发展后的终点或高潮。

senses.en: Using very few words in a way that seems rude.

ex.en: His curt reply made me hesitate to ask again.
ex.zh: 他生硬的回答让我犹豫着不敢再问。

ex.en: Curt responses from public service staff may discourage residents from seeking information about essential community support.
ex.zh: 公共服务人员生硬的回应可能使居民不愿咨询必要的社区援助信息。

tip: 不仅指简短，还带不礼貌之意；brief通常中性。

senses.en: A person or organisation responsible for protecting or managing something.
Someone employed to clean and maintain a building, especially in America.

ex.en: The custodian carefully locked the cabinet containing ancient coins.
ex.zh: 保管人小心地锁好了存放古钱币的柜子。

ex.en: Museums act as custodians of cultural heritage, preserving valuable objects for research and future generations.
ex.zh: 博物馆充当文化遗产的守护者，为研究和后代保存珍贵物品。

tip: custodian of后接所保管或守护的对象。

senses.en: To leave someone confused and unable to think clearly.
A state of confusion or reduced awareness.

ex.en: The sudden crash dazed me for a moment.
ex.zh: 突如其来的撞击声让我一时发懵。

ex.en: After several nights of poor sleep, employees may work in a daze and make avoidable mistakes.
ex.zh: 连续几晚睡眠不足后，员工可能工作时精神恍惚，犯下本可避免的错误。

tip: in a daze指恍惚；表示光线刺眼通常用dazzle。

senses.en: so bright that it is difficult to see
extremely impressive because of beauty, skill, or quality

ex.en: We shielded our eyes from the dazzling afternoon sun.
ex.zh: 我们遮住眼睛，躲避午后刺眼的阳光。

ex.en: Although dazzling performances attract visitors, sustained investment in local arts education is equally important.
ex.zh: 尽管精彩的演出能吸引游客，持续投资本地艺术教育也同样重要。

tip: 既可形容光线刺眼，也可形容表现精彩。

senses.en: A situation where disagreement prevents any further progress.

ex.en: Our discussion reached a deadlock over who should pay.
ex.zh: 我们在该由谁付款的问题上争执不下，讨论陷入了僵局。

ex.en: An independent mediator may help break the deadlock when negotiations between employers and workers fail.
ex.zh: 当雇主与员工之间的谈判失败时，独立调解员可能帮助打破僵局。

tip: 常与reach或break搭配；强调分歧导致无法推进。

senses.en: To make someone unable to hear, temporarily or permanently.

ex.en: The sudden blast of the horn nearly deafened me.
ex.zh: 突然响起的喇叭声差点把我震聋了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to loud industrial machinery can deafen workers unless effective hearing protection is consistently provided.
ex.zh: 如果不能持续提供有效的听力防护，长期接触高噪声工业机械可能使工人失聪。

tip: 指使人听不见，不指给房间做隔音。

senses.en: No longer alive, especially in formal or legal contexts.
A person or people who have died.

ex.en: She keeps a photograph of her deceased grandfather nearby.
ex.zh: 她在身边放着一张已故祖父的照片。

ex.en: Museums sometimes display personal belongings of deceased artists to help visitors understand their lives and creative influences.
ex.zh: 博物馆有时会展出已故艺术家的私人物品，帮助参观者了解其生平和创作所受的影响。

tip: 正式用语；the deceased可指一位或多位死者。

senses.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.

ex.en: His deceit became clear when we opened the empty box.
ex.zh: 我们打开空盒子时，他的骗局就暴露了。

ex.en: Deceit in advertising can damage consumer trust and create unfair advantages for companies that misrepresent their products.
ex.zh: 广告中的欺骗行为会损害消费者信任，并让虚假宣传产品的企业获得不公平的优势。

tip: deceit通常不可数；一次欺骗可用an act of deceit。

senses.en: work out the meaning of unclear writing or coded information

ex.en: Can you decipher the handwriting on this old postcard?
ex.zh: 你能辨认出这张旧明信片上的字迹吗？

ex.en: Researchers used advanced imaging techniques to decipher damaged manuscripts and gain insights into ancient societies.
ex.zh: 研究人员运用先进成像技术解读受损手稿，深入了解古代社会。

tip: 只作动词；既可指破译密码，也可指辨认潦草字迹。

senses.en: An official order issued by a ruler, government, or court.
To officially order or decide that something must happen.

ex.en: The new decree means our street stays closed tonight.
ex.zh: 新颁布的法令意味着今晚我们这条街将继续封闭。

ex.en: The government issued a decree requiring factories to treat wastewater before releasing it into rivers.
ex.zh: 政府颁布法令，要求工厂将废水处理后再排入河流。

tip: 动词可接that从句；名词指有权威的正式命令。

senses.en: Having a fault that prevents something from working properly.

ex.en: The shop replaced my defective kettle without any fuss.
ex.zh: 商店很爽快地换掉了我那只有故障的水壶。

ex.en: Manufacturers should recall defective products promptly to protect consumers and maintain public confidence in safety standards.
ex.zh: 制造商应及时召回有缺陷的产品，以保护消费者并维持公众对安全标准的信心。

tip: 常形容产品、零件或系统有缺陷，不能正常运作。

senses.en: A person or organisation facing a legal claim or criminal charge.

ex.en: The defendant sat quietly beside her lawyer in court.
ex.zh: 被告在法庭上安静地坐在她的律师旁边。

ex.en: Every defendant should have access to legal advice, regardless of their income or social background.
ex.zh: 每位被告都应能获得法律咨询，无论其收入或社会背景如何。

tip: 被告不等于罪犯；原告plaintiff主要用于民事诉讼。

senses.en: not having enough of something necessary
not good enough in quality or performance

ex.en: The doctor said my diet was deficient in iron.
ex.zh: 医生说我的饮食中铁摄入不足。

ex.en: Communities with deficient healthcare services often face greater difficulties in preventing disease and supporting older residents.
ex.zh: 医疗服务不完善的社区往往在疾病预防和老年居民照护方面面临更大困难。

tip: 缺乏某物用be deficient in，常见于营养和能力描述。

senses.en: the amount by which spending exceeds income
a shortage of something needed

ex.en: Our club faces a deficit after buying new equipment.
ex.zh: 购买新设备后，我们俱乐部出现了资金缺口。

ex.en: Governments may reduce a budget deficit by raising taxes, but this can slow economic growth.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过增税减少预算赤字，但这可能减缓经济增长。

tip: 赤字用deficit；债务用debt，二者不同。

senses.en: A change in direction caused by contact or another force
The act of directing attention or criticism away from something

ex.en: A slight deflection sent the ball past the goalkeeper.
ex.zh: 球稍稍变向，便从守门员身旁飞了过去。

ex.en: Engineers measure the deflection of structural beams to assess whether a bridge can safely support heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 工程师测量结构梁的挠度，以评估桥梁能否安全承受繁重交通。

tip: 强调受力后改变方向；工程中也指构件挠曲。

senses.en: a change in shape caused by pressure or other forces

ex.en: The heat caused visible deformation of the plastic lid.
ex.zh: 高温使塑料盖出现了明显变形。

ex.en: Engineers test building materials to assess their resistance to deformation under heavy loads and extreme temperatures.
